newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate slides on firm peso.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate slides on firm peso.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates opened down 60 basis points at 22.90 percent and are expected to trend downwards on lower yields on U.S. long bonds, traders said.
"The markets are much calmer now, the U.S. long bond (yield) is down and the peso is firm. Many foreign investors are stepping in," a trader said.
U.S. 30-year Treasury bonds were up 14/32 to yield 7.08 percent.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts were meanwhile 3.85 centavos stronger at 7.9040/7.9075 per dollar.
